source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 16 martie — «Sfântul Dimitrie, regele Georgiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Δημήτριος βασιλεύς της Γεωργίας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 1289)» and calls him Δημήτριος ο Β', ο Θυσιαζόμενος, Demetrius II the Self-sacrificed, son of David king of Georgia, who reposed in 1269, and of the Bagratid dynasty, martyred in 1289 by the Turks under the sultan Arghun. The Greek calendar sets him on 12 March while the Romanian, which this folder already carried, keeps him on 16 March; the two days are recorded and neither is moved.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Μαρτύρησε το έτος 1289 μ.Χ. από τους Τούρκους, επί σουλτάνου Αργκούν», and the page heads him «(; - 1289)», leaving the year of his birth a question mark. The corpus held no year for him before this.
